keyword: concrete pump main cylinder seal φ63

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a main-cylinder seal kit marked φ63. That mark is an outer-diameter style mark. Pump model and service life are not printed.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械把主油缸密封套件标为 φ63。该标记是外径写法。没有印泵型号和寿命。

h1.en: Concrete pump main cylinder seal φ63
h1.zh: 混凝土泵主油缸密封 φ63

directAnswer.en: The φ63 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only φ63.

body.en: φ63 is an outer-diameter style mark on the main-cylinder seal kit. Unit: set. Material is not printed. Service life is not printed.
body.zh: φ63 是主油缸密封套件上的外径写法。单位：套。材料没有印。寿命没有印。

body.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Some pump pages name a hydraulic pump such as a Kawasaki unit. That cell is not this seal kit, and it is not a spare-part page for a hydraulic pump.
body.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 有的泵页写了川崎等液压泵。那一格不是这套密封，也不是液压泵的配件页。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Copy the mark as φ63. Do not normalise 90–160 into 90×160, and do not turn 461K into a diameter.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 标记按 φ63 原文抄。不要把 90–160 规范成 90×160，也不要把 461K 改成直径。

question.en: Which pump model is assigned to φ63?

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

question.en: Is there a list price or a small parcel?

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp.
answer.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。

question.en: Are these OEM parts of another brand?
question.zh: 这是其他品牌的原厂件吗？

answer.en: The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands.
answer.zh: 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。

question.en: Where do I send the size?

answer.en: Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 主油缸密封 page plus this size and the quantity.
answer.zh: 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明主油缸密封这一页、这一尺寸和数量。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
